title: Désirée's Baby
author: Kate Chopin
short_description: A Louisiana plantation wife is cast out when her baby shows signs of Black ancestry — but the truth points elsewhere.
description: Désirée is abandoned by her husband Armand when their baby's appearance suggests African ancestry — but the letter he burns reveals the truth is the reverse. Chopin's most shattering story of racial prejudice and its ironic destruction of the bigot.
